name: Redondasuchus
sum: Redondasuchus is an aetosaur of the Typothoracisinae from the Redonda Formation, possibly a junior synonym of Typothorax.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from the Redonda Formation (4 PBDB occurrences).
